answer.reason: The Ziphites' report to Saul about David and the fortifying of Ziph are events of the place, beyond the town lists.

clauses.english: was where the Ziphites told Saul that David hid in their land
clauses.quote: Doth not David hide himself with us in strong holds in the wood

clauses.english: was built up as a fenced city in Judah
clauses.quote: And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,

doubts: 1CH 2:42 names Ziph as a son of Mesha, a person, so it was left out.
JOS 15:55 only lists the town, so it was left out.
The builder in 2CH 11:6-10 is not named in the verses given.
